title: 10 product ideas on the StonkFun developer platform: x402, agentic commerce, and cross-sector gaps

user_context.prompt: Run solana.new for product ideas around stonkfun.xyz (developers page). Create 10 ideas we can evaluate. Interested in x402 and agentic commerce ideas, plus anything that meets market needs across different sectors.
summary: Founder edge (carried from the 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-05 sessions): live x402 payment infra already built (solenrich, cardex), fast shipping on Next.js + Solana, agent tooling experience, Farcaster and Solana distribution. Missing: a trading or launchpad audience, and no on-chain program experience in production.

WHAT STONKFUN IS (fetched 2026-09-06). A non-custodial launchpad on Solana where every coin is priced against a quote asset instead of SOL: 26 xStocks (SPYX, NVDAX, TSLAX, GLDX...), Backpack pre-stocks (MU, SNDK, DRAM, ROBOSTRATEGY), the ANTHROPIC pre-stock, currencies (USDC, EURC, USDT, ONYC), the xSOL leverage token, and ~300 custom meme pairs. 349 launchable pairs today. Launches go through Raydium LaunchLab (0.03 SOL deploy) into CPMM pools.

PLATFORM NUMBERS (GET /stats, 2026-09-06): 8,166 tokens, 666 graduated ($40k mcap bar), 5,615 reward-mode launches (69% of all launches), $254M total market cap, $45M 24h volume, $1.95M lifetime platform revenue, $1.14M STONK buybacks, 27,079 burns.

DEVELOPER API. Plain HTTP at /api/public/v1, OpenAPI spec published, no API key, no signup. Two-call launch (prepare -> sign locally -> submit), fee claims, and 12 read endpoints (tokens, fees, rewards, airdrop, backing, burns, launches ledger, pairs, launchlab pricing, revenue history, stats). Rate limits 300/min per IP (25/min for prepare). NO webhooks and NO streaming: everything is polling. Standard mode: creator earns 0.5% of every trade (1.5% on the 2% tier). Reward mode: a 1% or 3% Token-2022 transfer tax is auto-paid to all holders in the quote token (e.g. holders of a NVDAX-paired coin receive NVDAX). Airdrop feature carves up to 50% of supply to top100..top5000 holders of the quote token. Self-built LaunchLab launches are 'adopted' only if every curve parameter matches; a typo in transferFeeBasePoints or maxinumFee silently creates a zero-rate tax.

x402 ON SOLANA (Sept 2026): Solana overtook Base in x402 tx count and volume on 2026-09-03, now >90% of weekly x402 transactions, 37M+ txs, 70% of monthly volume. Global x402: ~200M txs, ~$50B volume, ~150k merchant endpoints. Most payments are under $0.50 and >99.99% USDC. PayAI/BlockRun settled 5.4M agent payments in one week. This is the rail every idea below monetizes on.

TOKENIZED STOCKS: Solana did $5.8B spot DEX volume in tokenized equities in Q2 2026 (+114% QoQ), daily ATH $683M, cumulative >$10B, 96% of all tokenized stock trades across chains. PreStocks >$750M cumulative. Backpack listed SpaceX via Sunrise on IPO day. StonkFun is the only launchpad that lets a coin be priced in these assets.

AGENT ACTIVITY: automated agents are the majority of Solana DEX volume and >70% on peak launch days. ~65% of agentic AI payments run on Solana. Virtuals (Base) has launched ~14,000 agent tokens and its Agent Commerce Protocol handles agent-to-agent escrow; there is no Solana-native equivalent that pairs agent tokens with real assets.

COMPETITIVE LANDSCAPE: bags.fm (Meteora DBC, 1% fee share to royalty recipients, developer API at dev.bags.fm, a published Claude Code skill, JackBuilds shipped 35 tools from the Bags hackathon), pump.fun (API, largest volume), FeeSweep (creator fee command center across Bags and Pump.fun; does not cover StonkFun), SolMachina (x402 token-risk API at $0.001-$0.10 per call on Base and Solana), Helius webhooks (generic on-chain events, not StonkFun-aware). Nobody has built agent tooling, event streams, or analytics specific to StonkFun's quote-pair and reward-tax model.

HOW TO READ THE SCORES: 0-3 per dimension, founder fit weighs most, then MVP speed, distribution, market pull, revenue. Integration-first: 8 of 10 ideas need no new on-chain program. Ideas #9 (fee-stream market) and #10 (index vault) need custom programs and are marked as such.

clarifying_answers.question: What breaks if the blockchain is removed?
clarifying_answers.answer: For the gateway, preflight, events, and analytics ideas: nothing about the data layer, but everything about payment and access. StonkFun has no API keys, so the only way for an anonymous agent to pay for a premium call is a wallet signature (x402). For fee-stream and index ideas: the fee positions and reward taxes are on-chain state, so the product cannot exist off-chain.

clarifying_answers.question: Why hasn't StonkFun built these itself?
clarifying_answers.answer: They are a two-person-scale team that spent the last month on the LaunchLab program integration (per their X updates). Their roadmap is the core launch flow and STONK buybacks. Agent tooling, webhooks, analytics, and creator finance are the classic third-party layer around a launchpad, the same way JackBuilds, FeeSweep and Trojan grew around Bags and Pump.

clarifying_answers.question: What is the assumed founder edge?
clarifying_answers.answer: Working x402 server and client code, Solana + Next.js speed, and an existing agent-payments mental model. No launchpad audience yet. Ideas that sell to agent builders and to StonkFun's own creator community score higher on distribution than ideas that need retail traders.

clarifying_answers.question: Report theme?
clarifying_answers.answer: Glass, matching the previous two reports in this folder.

ideas.name: StonkFun Agent Gateway: MCP server + x402 orchestration API
ideas.one_liner: One paid call that lets any AI agent launch a coin paired with any asset, dev-buy, claim fees, and poll status, exposed as an MCP server, a Claude Code skill, and x402 endpoints listed in the bazaar.
ideas.why_it_wins: Best founder fit (reuses the x402 stack), fastest MVP (StonkFun's API is open and documented, so week one is orchestration and packaging), obvious first users (agent builders already shipping Bags tools, and StonkFun's Telegram), and it is the natural home for the two runner-up ideas as paid endpoints. StonkFun is agent-ready (no API key) but not agent-native: there is no MCP, no skill, no idempotent prepare->sign->submit->poll->claim wrapper, and no wallet-funding path for an agent that holds USDC but not SOL.
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: The customer is an anonymous agent with a wallet. It cannot sign up for a Stripe account. x402 is the only way to charge it per call, and the launch itself is a non-custodial on-chain action that the agent's key must sign. The gateway also fronts the 0.03 SOL deploy fee and gets repaid in USDC over x402, which is programmable money doing work Stripe cannot.
ideas.kill_this_idea: If agents keep calling StonkFun's free API directly and nobody pays for orchestration, the product is a thin wrapper. Kill if fewer than 50 paid launches or 1,000 paid calls in the first 30 days after the bazaar listing.
ideas.why_not_web2: A Web2 SaaS needs accounts, KYC, and card billing for machine customers that have none. x402 + wallet signatures give per-call billing and authorization with zero onboarding, which is exactly StonkFun's own design philosophy extended one layer up.
ideas.integration_note: Integration only. Wraps /launches/prepare, /launches/submit, /launches/{sig}, /tokens/{mint}/fees/claim/*, and reads. Uses the existing x402 server (solenrich/cardex) and the PayAI or CDP facilitator on Solana.

Move fast, become the listed skill first, and offer to hand it to them as the official one in exchange for a fee-share or platform pairing.

ideas.name: Launch Preflight + Reward-Coin Risk API (x402)
ideas.one_liner: A paid endpoint that validates a self-built LaunchLab launch against StonkFun's pricing rules before broadcast, and scores any live reward coin for whether its transfer tax is real, adopted, and paying holders.
ideas.why_it_wins: Runner-up, not winner, only because it is a feature-sized product. It solves a documented, painful, silent failure: StonkFun's docs warn that a mismatched curve parameter or a typo in the transfer-fee fields creates a launch that is never adopted, so fees forward to nobody and the tax accrues to nobody. On the read side, 5,615 reward launches exist and no tool tells a buyer whether a coin's reward flywheel is active. SolMachina proves people pay $0.001-$0.10 per x402 risk call.
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: The checks read on-chain mint extensions, pool accounts, and adoption state; the buyers are trading bots and launch agents paying per call with a wallet. Both halves are on-chain state consumed by wallet-holding machines.
ideas.kill_this_idea: If StonkFun adds a validate endpoint to the free API, the preflight half dies overnight; the reward-risk half survives only if bots actually route trades based on it. Kill if fewer than 500 paid calls in 30 days.
ideas.why_not_web2: Callers are anonymous bots that will not create accounts, and the data is on-chain. A free web page could exist, but the revenue is per-call machine payments.
ideas.integration_note: Integration only. Reads GET /launchlab/pricing, GET /tokens/{mint}, GET /tokens/{mint}/rewards, plus Token-2022 mint extension state via RPC (Helius DAS).

ideas.name: Reward Yield Screener: 'dividend APR' for quote-paired coins
ideas.one_liner: The first screener that computes holder yield for StonkFun reward coins (transfer tax paid in NVDAX, SPYX, USDC...) as an APR, plus quote-exposure and fee-earnings leaderboards, with a free web UI and an x402 data API for agents.
ideas.why_it_wins: Third because the buyer is a trader, which is not the founder's audience, but the metric gap is real: 69% of StonkFun launches are reward coins whose holders receive real assets, and no dashboard turns 'rewards distributed / market cap' into a yield number. Yield is what makes the asset-paired model legible to non-degens.
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: Every input (distributions, holder counts, tax rate, quote price) is on-chain and the reward itself is programmable money. Agents consume the API by paying per call.
ideas.kill_this_idea: If Birdeye or DexScreener add a 'holder yield' column, the screener is a feature of theirs. Kill if under 300 weekly active users after the first month.
ideas.why_not_web2: A Web2 screener is possible for humans, but the API half (machine payments, no accounts) and the data source are only on-chain.
ideas.integration_note: Integration only. GET /tokens, /tokens/{mint}/rewards, /rewards, /revenue/history, plus Jupiter price API for quote assets.

ideas.name: Autonomous Launch Agent: news-to-coin on xStock pairs
ideas.one_liner: An agent that watches earnings, IPO, and macro events, launches a reward-mode coin paired with the relevant xStock or pre-stock (NVDAX on earnings night, the SpaceX pair on IPO day), seeds it with a dev buy, and pays its own token holders from the creator fee.
ideas.why_it_wins: Not the winner. Highest market pull on paper (agents already dominate launch-day volume and Virtuals proved agent tokens sell), but it is a speculation product that the founder would have to operate, with real reputational and regulatory exposure. It also ships as a customer of idea #1 rather than a product of its own.
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: The agent's revenue is an on-chain creator fee position it owns; its holders are paid by a token-level transfer tax. Nothing here has a Web2 equivalent.
ideas.kill_this_idea: If the coins it launches consistently rug or die in hours, the agent is a pump machine with your name on it. Kill if the first five launches average under 48 hours of trading or draw complaints.
ideas.why_not_web2: There is no off-chain way for a program to own a revenue-bearing asset it created without a legal entity.
ideas.integration_note: Integration only, built on idea #1 plus a news feed and a Jupiter swap for the dev buy.

ideas.name: Creator Revenue Ops: multi-launchpad fee sweeping with agent payouts

ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: Fees are on-chain positions that must be claimed by the creator's key; payouts to anonymous contributors and agents settle in USDC without accounts.
ideas.kill_this_idea: FeeSweep adds StonkFun in a weekend. Kill if a comparable tool covers StonkFun before you have 20 paying studios.
ideas.why_not_web2: Claims require wallet signatures and payouts go to wallets; no bank rails involved.

ideas.name: StonkFun Events: webhooks, streams, and alerts as a service
ideas.one_liner: The missing push layer for a polling-only API: webhooks and WebSocket streams for new launches on a given quote asset, graduation, reward distributions, fee accrual, and buybacks, plus Telegram and X alert bots; agents subscribe by paying per event over x402.
ideas.why_it_wins: Not the winner. It fills a confirmed gap (the OpenAPI spec exposes no webhooks or streaming) and is a fast build, but per-event revenue is small and Helius webhooks are a partial substitute. Best shipped as the subscription feature of idea #1.
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: Subscribers are agents paying per event with wallets; the events are on-chain.
ideas.kill_this_idea: StonkFun adds webhooks, or agents are fine with 300 polls per minute. Kill if fewer than 20 paying subscriber wallets in 30 days.
ideas.why_not_web2: A Web2 alert SaaS works for humans; the machine subscribers pay per event without accounts.
ideas.integration_note: Integration only. Poll /tokens, /launches, /rewards, /revenue at the rate limit; Helius webhooks on the LaunchLab program for lower latency.

ideas.name: Holder Cohort Acquisition: airdrop-targeted launches for brands and projects
ideas.one_liner: A B2B tool that turns StonkFun's airdrop feature into customer acquisition: pick a quote-asset cohort (top 5,000 TSLAX holders, top 100 JUP holders), preview the snapshot, launch a coin that drops up to 50% of supply to them, and track activation, with an x402 endpoint that sells cohort snapshots to agents.
ideas.why_it_wins: Not the winner. Distinct sector and a real on-chain primitive (frozen holder snapshot, exchange wallets excluded), but the buyer (project marketers) is hard to reach from the founder's network and the outcome metric (activation) is unproven.
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: The cohort is defined by on-chain holdings, the drop settles at launch, and the recipients are wallets. A Web2 ad network cannot target 'holds TSLAX' or deliver an asset.
ideas.kill_this_idea: If airdropped holders dump instantly and never engage, the cohort has no value. Kill if the first three campaigns show under 5% of recipients making any second interaction.
ideas.why_not_web2: Targeting by wallet holdings and delivering value into the wallet is not possible off-chain.
ideas.integration_note: Integration only. /launches/prepare with airdropPercent/airdropTier/airdropSource, /tokens/{mint}/airdrop for results, Helius DAS for holder analytics.

ideas.name: Fee Stream Market: trade and borrow against creator fee positions
ideas.one_liner: A marketplace and lending pool for StonkFun creator fee positions: sell the next 30 days of a coin's 0.5% trade fees for USDC today, or borrow against a graduated coin's fee history; positions transfer through the Fee Key NFT referenced in the API.
ideas.why_it_wins: Not the winner. Best revenue logic of the ten (creators want liquidity, buyers want cash-flowing assets) but it needs a custom on-chain program, an audit, and a legal view on selling fee streams. That is a multi-month build for a solo founder without a program track record.
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: The fee position is on-chain, verifiable, and transferable; escrow and repayment can be enforced by program, not contract law.
ideas.kill_this_idea: If the Fee Key NFT is not transferable or StonkFun changes fee custody, the primitive does not exist. Confirm this with the team before writing any code. Also kill if fee streams are too volatile for any buyer to price.
ideas.why_not_web2: Selling future revenue off-chain requires a legal entity, contracts, and enforcement; on-chain it is an escrowed asset transfer.
ideas.integration_note: Custom program required (escrow of the Fee Key NFT, claim routing, repayment). Not integration-only.

ideas.name: Reward Coin Index Vault: a yield-bearing basket per quote asset
ideas.one_liner: A vault token that holds the top reward coins paired with one quote asset (e.g. the NVDAX basket), auto-harvests the transfer-tax dividends, and either compounds or pays them out, giving buyers diversified meme exposure with real-asset dividends.
ideas.why_it_wins: Not the winner, and closest to a kill. It needs a vault program and rebalancing logic, the underlying coins have short lives, and a basket of memes with dividends will be read as a security. Included because it is the sector-complete DeFi answer and would be the natural consumer of idea #3's data.
ideas.why_crypto_is_necessary: Composability: the vault holds on-chain positions and receives on-chain dividends automatically.
ideas.kill_this_idea: Most constituents die within weeks and the vault becomes a bag of dust. Kill unless idea #3 shows at least 20 reward coins with 90-day survival and steady yield.
ideas.why_not_web2: There is no off-chain way to hold and harvest these positions.
ideas.integration_note: Custom program required (vault, rebalancing, harvest). Not integration-only.
